title: Wireweave 4 language bundle
description: Canonical AST bundle. Cross-reference, ownership, data-flow, limit and execution checks in LANGUAGE and RUNTIME are mandatory in addition to JSON Schema.

w.description: Box dimension; numeric values are CSS pixels. Bounds accept numeric/unit only.

h.description: Box dimension; numeric values are CSS pixels. Bounds accept numeric/unit only.

minW.description: Box dimension; numeric values are CSS pixels. Bounds accept numeric/unit only.

maxW.description: Box dimension; numeric values are CSS pixels. Bounds accept numeric/unit only.

minH.description: Box dimension; numeric values are CSS pixels. Bounds accept numeric/unit only.

maxH.description: Box dimension; numeric values are CSS pixels. Bounds accept numeric/unit only.

width.description: Fixed page viewport dimension in CSS pixels.

height.description: Fixed page viewport dimension in CSS pixels.

x.description: Canvas page position or relative-container child offset in CSS pixels.

y.description: Canvas page position or relative-container child offset in CSS pixels.

flex.description: False disables flex; true enables; nonnegative number sets grow.

direction.description: Flex direction; row defaults row and col/stack default column.

align.description: Cross-axis alignment on containers; text alignment on text/title/link.

wrap.description: Wrap within authored viewport; never relative to host viewport.

span.description: Twelve-column span; breakpoint chosen once against fixed profile width.

sm.description: Twelve-column span; breakpoint chosen once against fixed profile width.

md.description: Twelve-column span; breakpoint chosen once against fixed profile width.

lg.description: Twelve-column span; breakpoint chosen once against fixed profile width.

xl.description: Twelve-column span; breakpoint chosen once against fixed profile width.

order.description: Visual order; semantic/focus order stays source order and mismatches are diagnosed.

position.description: Component-relative side or corner; component domain restrictions apply.

border.description: Boolean semantic/layout attribute; omitted is false unless a component default states otherwise.

rounded.description: Boolean semantic/layout attribute; omitted is false unless a component default states otherwise.

muted.description: Boolean semantic/layout attribute; omitted is false unless a component default states otherwise.

bold.description: Boolean semantic/layout attribute; omitted is false unless a component default states otherwise.

danger.description: Boolean semantic/layout attribute; omitted is false unless a component default states otherwise.

required.description: Boolean semantic/layout attribute; omitted is false unless a component default states otherwise.

disabled.description: Boolean semantic/layout attribute; omitted is false unless a component default states otherwise.

readonly.description: Boolean semantic/layout attribute; omitted is false unless a component default states otherwise.

checked.description: Boolean semantic/layout attribute; omitted is false unless a component default states otherwise.

loading.description: Boolean semantic/layout attribute; omitted is false unless a component default states otherwise.

external.description: Boolean semantic/layout attribute; omitted is false unless a component default states otherwise.

expanded.description: Boolean semantic/layout attribute; omitted is false unless a component default states otherwise.

centered.description: Boolean semantic/layout attribute; omitted is false unless a component default states otherwise.

vertical.description: Boolean semantic/layout attribute; omitted is false unless a component default states otherwise.

scroll.description: Boolean semantic/layout attribute; omitted is false unless a component default states otherwise.

dismissible.description: Boolean semantic/layout attribute; omitted is false unless a component default states otherwise.

indeterminate.description: Boolean semantic/layout attribute; omitted is false unless a component default states otherwise.

pill.description: Boolean semantic/layout attribute; omitted is false unless a component default states otherwise.

striped.description: Boolean semantic/layout attribute; omitted is false unless a component default states otherwise.

bordered.description: Boolean semantic/layout attribute; omitted is false unless a component default states otherwise.

hover.description: Boolean semantic/layout attribute; omitted is false unless a component default states otherwise.

ordered.description: Boolean semantic/layout attribute; omitted is false unless a component default states otherwise.

none.description: Boolean semantic/layout attribute; omitted is false unless a component default states otherwise.

shadow.description: Neutral elevation cue; not an arbitrary brand shadow.

size.description: Named text/control/icon size or pixel icon/avatar/spinner size; see component domain.

variant.description: Semantic status; neutral rendering also exposes text and icon meaning.

placeholder.description: Human text; name on icon is validated against pinned icon dataset.

label.description: Human text; name on icon is validated against pinned icon dataset.

name.description: Human text; name on icon is validated against pinned icon dataset.

title.description: Human text; name on icon is validated against pinned icon dataset.

alt.description: Human text; name on icon is validated against pinned icon dataset.

aria.description: Human text; name on icon is validated against pinned icon dataset.

aria-label.description: Human text; name on icon is validated against pinned icon dataset.

value.description: Scalar control value or bound output; actual type is checked per component.

min.description: Native numeric range; slider defaults min=0 max=100 step=1; step must be positive.

max.description: Native numeric range; slider defaults min=0 max=100 step=1; step must be positive.

step.description: Native numeric range; slider defaults min=0 max=100 step=1; step must be positive.

src.description: Asset source; true is allowed on avatar only and means an authored neutral placeholder.

href.description: Declared asset or URL, validated by output security profile; no JavaScript or arbitrary data URLs.

icon.description: Name in the release-pinned Lucide icon dataset; no remote glyph resolution.

active.description: Tabs use zero-based integer, navigation item uses boolean in static projections.

viewport.description: WIDTHxHEIGHT, numeric width with default height 900; device/size duplicates must agree.

device.description: Named fixed viewport; dimensions are defined in LANGUAGE.

navigate.description: Bare name is an internal screen id, never a display title; external URL uses typed url target or href.

opens.description: Structural/reference shorthand normalized before semantic validation.

toggles.description: Structural/reference shorthand normalized before semantic validation.

action.description: Structural/reference shorthand normalized before semantic validation.

uses.description: Structural/reference shorthand normalized before semantic validation.

on.description: Typed event handlers; canonical AST uses handler arrays.

visibleWhen.description: Runtime outcome guard; visibility also removes focus/accessibility exposure.

enabledWhen.description: Runtime outcome guard; visibility also removes focus/accessibility exposure.

states.description: State declarations scoped to the owning app/layout/page/component instance.

variants.description: Review board labels of one screen; never separate screen identities.

when.description: Compile-time variant projection membership, independent of runtime guard.

id.description: Authored stable id; normalized Node.id owns it and attributes.id is omitted from canonical AST.

anchor.description: Anchor to nearest relative container; x/y are additional pixel offsets.

color.description: Annotation category retained as data and distinguishable labels; neutral profile does not require color.

options.description: Select option declarations; positional strings normalize to equal label/value.

bind.description: Control value binding; state is the only mutable source of truth.

obligationRefs.description: Product registry IDs; resolve without copying editable requirement prose.

requirementRefs.description: Product registry IDs; resolve without copying editable requirement prose.

role.description: Semantic role override only when compatible with the element; native semantics take precedence.

buttonType.description: Native button type; default button; submit/reset require form ownership.

form.description: Owning form id in same screen/shell instance.

autocomplete.description: Native autocomplete purpose; no credential persistence in fixture.

minLength.description: String length bound counted in Unicode code points.

maxLength.description: String length bound counted in Unicode code points.

initialFocus.description: First focus target when an overlay opens; must be inside overlay.

modal.description: Drawer modality; default true. Modal primitive is always modal.

data.description: Read-only expression for table/list/text data; never arbitrary JavaScript.

columns.description: Table column names; must be unique for sorting/filtering.
